caption: GP-RareLink pipeline and its database-held-out evaluation. Top lane: the extraction pipeline, frozen with pre-registration v1.0 on 2026-10-20. Open-access case reports found by PubMed and backward citation search and screened by Claude Sonnet helpers are read one paper per Claude Opus helper; every extracted value carries a verbatim quote and the PMID, and phenotypes are observed, excluded or not reported. A deterministic span check confirms each quote occurs verbatim in its paper (241,730 values, 0 problems, registered six diseases), a second Claude read (gatekeeper v4) keeps only claims it judges supported, and Stage 4 merges people only on explicit one-to-one citations, normalizes variants with VariantValidator on MANE Select while keeping the original string, binds HPO and Mondo terms and writes schema-validated GA4GH Phenopackets v2. An automated isolation test keeps ClinVar and OMIM out of extraction. Bottom lane: the harness reads a dated ClinVar snapshot and the OMIM entry pages frozen on 2026-10-28 only after extraction, to score concordance (O2) and list gap candidates absent from both databases (O3), for which evidence dossiers of verbatim quotes propose no classification. People then audit gatekeeper-supported claims (O1), triage ClinVar misses and adjudicate gap candidates; the gatekeeper's verdicts are a model reading, not an error rate, which only the human audit measures.
description: Two-lane left-to-right block diagram at ICLR text width (5.5 in; outline asked 21:9, drawn about 16:9 so all text stays at 8 pt). Top lane 'Extraction (pipeline/extract; frozen 2026-10-20, pre-registration v1.0)': 1 Corpus -> 2 Extraction -> 3 Span check (badge '241,730 values, 0 span-check problems (registered six)', the only number) -> 4 Gatekeeper v4 -> 5 Stage 4 -> 6 Output (GA4GH Phenopackets v2). Dark wall 'Isolation test: no ClinVar / OMIM in extraction'. Bottom lane 'Harness (held-out ground truth, read only after extraction)': Held-out reference (ClinVar snapshot, OMIM pages frozen 2026-10-28) -> O2 concordance and O3 gap candidates -> Evidence dossiers -> People (O1 audit, triage of ClinVar misses, gap adjudication; see human-assessment figure). Downward arrows: Output -> O2/O3 ('phenopackets'), Gatekeeper -> People ('supported claims'). No outcome values, no names, no pending human result.
